title: Protecting the Planet
text:
Our planet needs help. Many forests are being cut down every year. Trees give us clean air, so we must protect them. Some people plant new trees in their cities.

Recycling is another easy way to help. Plastic bottles, paper, and glass can be used again. When we throw away less rubbish, there is less pollution. Small actions can make a big difference.

questions.text: Why do some people plant trees in cities?
options: To help make the air cleaner

questions.text: What is the writer's main message?
options: Everyone can help protect the planet.

vocabulary.definition: the process of using materials again
harmful substances that make air, water, or land dirty
things you throw away, such as waste

paragraph_translations: Nuestro planeta necesita ayuda. Cada año se talan muchos bosques. Los árboles nos dan aire limpio, así que debemos protegerlos. Algunas personas plantan nuevos árboles en sus ciudades.

El reciclaje es otra forma fácil de ayudar. Las botellas de plástico, el papel y el vidrio se pueden volver a usar. Cuando tiramos menos basura, hay menos contaminación. Las pequeñas acciones pueden marcar una gran diferencia.
